{{Top|leg}}
A '''systems control unit''' was required to activate a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. [[Anscot]] constructed systems control units. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on [[Garos IV]] required a shipment of systems control units to complete a sensor network around the [[mining center complex]].
